description: Form long-term agent memory from a DataFrame of conversation turns using Mem0 (self-hosted) -- distinct from simple chat-history storage, this extracts and consolidates durable facts per user/session via an LLM + vector store, retrievable later via semantic search. Grouped per user (and optionally per agent/session) before calling Mem0's add() once per group.

inputs.description: One row per conversation turn (role + content), from upstream_asset_key.

outputs.description: No materialized value -- the asset's effect is writing memories into the configured (or demo) Mem0 store. Metadata reports groups_written/memories_written.

asset_name.label: Asset Name
asset_name.description: Dagster asset key emitted by this component.

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Upstream asset key providing a DataFrame of conversation turns -- one row per message.

user_id_column.label: User Id Column
user_id_column.description: Column identifying who the conversation is with. Rows are grouped by this (and agent_id_column/run_id_column, if set) before calling Mem0's add() once per group.

agent_id_column.label: Agent Id Column
agent_id_column.description: Column identifying which agent participated, if memories should be scoped per-agent as well as per-user.

run_id_column.label: Run Id Column
run_id_column.description: Column identifying the conversation/session, if memories should be scoped per-run rather than accumulated across a user's entire history.

content_column.label: Content Column
content_column.description: Column holding each turn's message text.

metadata_column.label: Metadata Column
metadata_column.description: Optional column holding a JSON object (or JSON string) of extra metadata to attach -- the first non-null value in each group is used.

infer.label: Infer
infer.description: Passed to Mem0's add(infer=...). true (default) runs fact extraction over the messages; false stores the raw messages verbatim with no extraction LLM call.

vector_store.label: Vector Store
vector_store.description: Mem0 vector_store config, e.g. {provider: qdrant, config: {host: localhost, port: 6333}}. Unset = Mem0's own on-disk default.

llm.label: LLM
llm.description: Mem0 llm config (used for fact extraction when infer=true), e.g. {provider: openai, config: {model: gpt-5-mini}}. Unset = Mem0's own default -- requires OPENAI_API_KEY.

embedder.label: Embedder
embedder.description: Mem0 embedder config, e.g. {provider: openai, config: {model: text-embedding-3-small}}. Unset = Mem0's own default.

validate_search.label: Validate Search
validate_search.description: After writing, run one Mem0 search() as a smoke check -- catches a silently-broken vector-store/embedder config. Emits a non-blocking (WARN) asset check.

validate_search_query.label: Validate Search Query
validate_search_query.description: Query text for the validate_search smoke check. Required when validate_search=true.

demo_mode.label: Demo Mode
demo_mode.description: Form memories against a local JSON-file-backed fake instead of a real Mem0/LLM/embedder stack. Set false for a real configuration.

demo_store_path.label: Demo Store Path
demo_store_path.description: Path to the local JSON file demo_mode reads/writes. Unset = './{asset_name}_agent_memory_demo.json'.

partition_type.description: Partition type: 'daily', 'weekly', 'monthly', 'hourly', 'static', 'multi', 'dynamic', or None for unpartitioned.
partition_type.label: Partition Type

partition_start.description: Partition start date in ISO format, e.g. '2024-01-01'. Required for time-based partition types.
partition_start.label: Partition Start

partition_cron_schedule.label: Partition Cron Schedule
partition_cron_schedule.description: Required when partition_type='cron'. A cron expression restricting the date axis to a custom cadence, e.g. '0 0 * * 1-5' for weekdays only (business-day cadence). Built on Dagster's TimeWindowPartitionsDefinition(cron_schedule=...).

partition_cron_fmt.label: Partition Cron Fmt
partition_cron_fmt.description: strftime format for partition keys produced by partition_type='cron'. Only change this for a sub-daily cron_schedule.

partition_end_offset.label: Partition End Offset
partition_end_offset.description: Passed through to the underlying Daily/Weekly/Monthly/Hourly/cron partitions definition. 0 (the Dagster default) means a time-based partition set only ever holds COMPLETED windows -- e.g. a daily set never includes today until tomorrow. Set to 1 to include the current, still-in-progress window.

partition_timezone.label: Partition Timezone
partition_timezone.description: IANA timezone for the underlying Daily/Weekly/Monthly/Hourly/cron partitions definition (defaults to UTC when unset, matching Dagster's own default).

backfill_policy.label: Backfill Policy
backfill_policy.description: Backfill execution strategy for a partitioned asset. 'single_run' materializes an entire backfill range in one Dagster run. 'multi_run' launches one run per partition (optionally capped via Backfill Max Partitions Per Run). Leave empty for Dagster's default. Ignored when no partitioning is configured.

backfill_policy_max_partitions_per_run.label: Backfill Max Partitions Per Run
backfill_policy_max_partitions_per_run.description: For Backfill Policy = 'multi_run' only: maximum partitions materialized per run. Leave empty for Dagster's default (1).

name: Agent Memory Store
